name: Robot Uprighting Unit
summary: Automatically converts products from horizontal to vertical orientation. Uses CCD vision to determine product position, and the robot automatically picks and completes the uprighting action.
contentHtml:
The Robot Uprighting Unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for product orientation conversion.

Working Principle

The device uses a CCD vision system to automatically determine the product position, guiding a six-axis robot to pick the product and complete the orientation conversion from horizontal to vertical. The uprighting process is smooth, effectively protecting product safety.

Technical Advantages

  • CCD vision guidance for accurate positioning
  • Smooth uprighting process to avoid product damage
  • Significantly reduces labor and improves efficiency
  • Customizable based on different product characteristics
